is_normalized.description: Whether the coordinates are normalized (0.0-1.0) or absolute pixel values

cam_resolution.description: Camera resolution must have exactly two non-negative integers representing [width, height].

items.description: Each point must have exactly two non-negative numbers representing [x, y] coordinates.

near_violation_window.description: Seconds before VIOLATION_TIME during which a track is considered near-violation and the report batch waits for it.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum seconds to keep batching near-violation tracks before forcing the event report.

heartbeat_interval.description: Seconds between heartbeat log summaries of pallet/product_package tracks on the floor (0 disables).

realert_interval.description: Seconds to wait before re-alerting on a previously reported violation (-1 disables).
